title: Kronecker sequences beyond the torus: nearest-neighbour distances and best returns
summary: We study nearest-neighbour distances and strict best returns of cyclic orbits on $(V\times G)/Λ$, where $V$ is a finite-dimensional real normed space, $G$ has a bi-invariant ultrametric, and $Λ$ is an arbitrary closed subgroup. For the quotient of the maximum product metric, the number of distinct nearest-neighbour distances in every finite orbit segment is at most $P(\overline V)+1$, where $P$ is an open-ball packing constant and $\overline V$ is obtained by factoring out the continuous real part of $Λ$. For inner-product norms the bound depends only on the span of the projected subgroup.…
